subject: Draft mutual action plan — milestone owners & procurement sign-off window
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novus.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft mutual action plan — milestone owners & procurement sign-off window

Hi Alyssa / Carlos,

Thanks again for the call this morning — helpful to align on scope and the internal procurement path. As promised, attached is Novus-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (high-level milestones, owners, and dependencies) plus a SOW-summary.pdf with the feature set and pricing header.

Quick recap and proposed target dates:
- Target close (commercial go/no-go): 2028-04-28
- Procurement / signature deadline (contract or PO issued to finance): 2028-04-21

High-level milestones (from the draft MAP):
1) Final SOW + pricing confirmation — Owner: Redwood (Karthik) — target 2028-03-27 — dependency: internal scope confirmation from Novus.
2) Security evidence & SOC2 artifacts — Owner: Redwood (Marissa) — target 2028-04-04 — dependency: Novus questionnaire completion and secure link exchange.
3) Legal review / DocuSign prep — Owner: Novus Legal (Alyssa) — target 2028-04-11 — dependency: final SOW and T&Cs.
4) Procurement PO issuance / signature — Owner: Novus Procurement (Carlos/Alyssa) — target 2028-04-21 (we suggested)
5) Implementation kickoff & onboarding scheduling — Owner: Novus implementation lead — target 2028-05-02 — dependency: signed contract / PO.

Ask from our side: can you confirm whether the 04/21 procurement cutoff is workable given your internal approval lanes? If not, what is the latest date we should plan to have docs in your legal queue to meet a close on 04/28?

Proposed next steps:
- Alyssa/Carlos: confirm procurement signature runway (yes/no + any calendar blackout dates).
- Novus: flag any additional contract terms or procurement steps we should add to the MAP (e.g., PO number format, invoice remittance, vendor setup lead times).
- Redwood: I will update the MAP with any feedback and deliver a final SOW by 2028-03-27.

Availability for a 30-minute sync next week to lock the dates: I have Tue/Thu mornings PST open — happy to work around your calendar.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novus.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan — milestone owners & procurement sign-off window

Thanks for the clear recap, Karthik — this is helpful. A couple of notes from procurement/legal side after a quick internal check: 

- Legal calendar: we have a board packet deadline the week of 2028-04-04 which pushes any substantive T&C negotiation start to the week of 2028-04-11 for our counsel.
- That said, procurement needs the final SOW and any proposed redlines by 2028-04-11 in order to get a PO out by 2028-04-25. If you can deliver SOW + proposed T&Cs by 2028-03-27 as you suggested, we will do our best to expedite reviews.
- We require SOC2 evidence and answers to the security questionnaire before legal signs off — target to receive those by 2028-04-05. Can Redwood confirm which artifacts will be included (e.g., SOC2 Type II report, data retention policy, encryption in transit docs)?
- There is one procurement constraint: our vendor onboarding team requires vendor paperwork (W9, vendor form) and initial invoice cadence details. If you can include a vendor onboarding checklist we can attach, that will speed the PO.

So, pragmatically, the dates that look realistic for us right now are:
- Final SOW sent by Redwood: 2028-03-27 (good)
- SOC2 + security artifacts: 2028-04-05 (target)
- Legal review window: 2028-04-11 — 2028-04-20
- PO / signature target: 2028-04-25 (slight shift from your 04/21)

I can join a quick 30-minute sync on Thu morning (03/23) at 10:00am PST if that works for you both.

Best,
Alyssa

Alyssa Chen
Head of Procurement, Novus Health
alyssa.chen@novus.com | +1 (617) 555-2299
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft mutual action plan — milestone owners & procurement sign-off window (internal)

Quick internal note — saw Alyssa's reply.

- Agree we should accept the 04/25 procurement cutoff (slightly later than we proposed) — lowers risk on their side.
- I can own the SOC2 evidence package and will gather: SOC2 Type II redacted PDF, encryption-in-transit writeup, and our data retention summary by 2028-04-04.
- I'll also create a short vendor onboarding checklist (W9, vendor form, initial invoice cadence) to include with the SOW delivery on 03/27.

If you want, I can take point on the Thu 03/23 call to confirm the exact artifacts and escalate any gaps.

—Marissa
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novus.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan — milestone owners & procurement sign-off window

Alyssa / Carlos — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarity on your internal lanes. Confirming our alignment below and next steps.

Updated agreed runway:
- Final SOW delivered by Redwood: 2028-03-27 (we will send the SOW-summary.pdf and full SOW link)
- Redwood security artifacts delivered: 2028-04-04 (Marissa to own — SOC2 Type II, data retention, encryption notes)
- Novus legal review window: 2028-04-11 through 2028-04-20
- Procurement / PO issuance: 2028-04-25 (target)
- Commercial close / kickoff: 2028-04-28

Action items: 
- Karthik (Redwood): update MAP with Alyssa's procurement window and send Novus-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (finalized) + full SOW link by 2028-03-27.
- Marissa (Redwood): assemble SOC2 artifacts and vendor onboarding checklist by 2028-04-04.
- Alyssa (Novus): confirm vendor onboarding form and send any procurement-specific PO fields (PO number format / invoice remittance) in the 03/23 call.

Can we lock Thu 03/23 10:00am PST for the 30-minute sync? If so I'll send a calendar invite with the updated MAP attached and add a short agenda: (1) confirm artifacts checklist, (2) legal timeline + redline owner, (3) procurement PO fields.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Karthik
